Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Tiny FNO on held-out heat problems Evaluate the same learned weights on 32/64-point grids, held-out functions and separate OOD inputs. Assumptions, units and boundaries Use periodic heat flow uₜ=νuₓₓ on [0,2π) to T=0.25. Split 46 whole problems into 24 training, 6 validation, 8 held-out ID, 4 viscosity-OOD and 4 spectrum-OOD problems. Use two fixed seeds and 93 real parameters. Editorial clarification This comparison concerns a fixed tiny discrete operator, without arbitrary-resolution, distributional or OOD guarantees. The N=64-to-32 discrepancy includes nonlinear aliasing and is not a continuum discretization error. Optimizer convergence is distinct from normal budget termination. The old heat primary remains. This [0,2pi) whole-problem family, diffusivities and final time are separate fixed inputs. Adopted numerical method Lift (u₀,ν) to width two and apply two blocks containing a local linear map, real DC and complex Fourier modes 1–4, then tanh. Train with a fixed L-BFGS-B budget and evaluate the same weights at N=32 and 64. Nonlinear terms are evaluated on each native grid without dealiasing. ut=νuxx,x∈[0,2π),u(x+2π,t)=u(x,t),T=14ut​=νuxx​,x∈[0,2π),u(x+2π,t)=u(x,t),T=41​ u^k(T)=e−νk2Tu^k(0)uk​(T)=e−νk2Tuk​(0) vℓ+1=tanh⁡ ⁣(Wℓvℓ+bℓ+FN−1(RℓFNvℓ)),ℓ=0,1vℓ+1=tanh(Wℓ​vℓ+bℓ​+FN−1​(Rℓ​FN​vℓ)),ℓ=0,1 relative error=RMS⁡(uθ−uref)RMS⁡(uref)only if RMS⁡(uref)>10−12relative error=RMS(uref​)RMS(uθ​−uref​)​only if RMS(uref​)>10−12 References and measured quantities Qualify all 93 real loss-gradient coordinates at two fixed finite-difference widths and compare Fourier blocks with direct DFT sums.
